tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtor bsngo don 'dus ma bzhugs pa'i dbu'o// na mo gu ru badzra bhai ra wā ya/ phye tshugs sam zlum gtor gang rung chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod phud chang bcas bshams nas/ nang mchod/ chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos gtsang mas bdug pa'am/ de yang ma 'grub tshe/ phye mar phran bu zhig bshams la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi ma he'i steng / /rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog nag /ma he'i zhal can gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /gcer bu khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs/ /me dpung dbus bzhugs gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs thim/ /dbang bskur mi bskyod pa yi rgyas btab gyur/ /oṃ hrīḥṣṭi wi kri tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas rjes/ mdun gyi mchod gtor rnams la dmigs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang / /mchod gtor rnam pa dgra bgegs sha khrag la/ /ngo bo zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed gsal ba'i mdun/ /me rlung khrag mtsho dre'u rgyan can steng / /dmag zor lha mo be con thod khrag 'dzin/ /dur khrod rgyan sogs cha lugs yongs su rdzogs/ /pad zla seng ge'i khri la rnam thos sras/ /gser gyi mdog can rgyal mtshan sre mong 'dzin/ /sra ba'i go gsol rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /phrag gong nyi zlas brgyan cing dgos 'dod stsol/ /btsan rta rag pa rgyan gyis spras pa'i steng / /rgyal chen bse khrab dmar po be con dang / /btsan zhags 'dzin cing khro bo'i chas kun rdzogs/ /dregs ldan seng ge'i khri la pe dkar sku/ /gangs ri'i mdog can zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /lcags kyu mda' dar spu gri gzhu dbyug thogs/ /sag zhu dar dkar na bza' stag chas can/

/rdo rje rigs ldan 'khor tshogs bcas pas bskor/ /myur mgyogs rta mchog dre'u rgyan spras steng / rtsi dmar rā ga ltar dmar mdung zhags 'dzin/ /btsan chas yongs rdzogs khro gtum rngams brjid sku/ rong lha rgyal mtshan/ /rdzu 'phrul rlung gi shugs 'chang rta nag steng / /khro gtum srid gsum g.yo ba'i gar stabs can/ /g.yas pa mdung rnon g.yon pa dgra snying 'dzin/ /bdud mgon dmag dpon chen po mngon sum bzhin/ /mi zan dred steng rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /ljang khu phyag gnyis rdo rje tsitta bsnams/ /dmar ljang gos gsol rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /khyod sku phug khang rgyal po 'dren byed stong gi rab gang zhing / /khyod lto khro zhal gdong pa srin po'i gzugs/ /khyod mjug sbrul ltar 'khyug pa rā hū la/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje tsitta 'dzin zhing sdigs/ /kun kyang dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ /mu le deng dang byang phyogs lcang lo can/ /gsang phu gnas chung bsam yas rong gi phu/ /rma ri skyor mo lung sogs gnas mchog nas/ /bstan bsrung 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha sarba sha truṃ bighnan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyai 'dir bzhugs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /khyed rnams gang la dges pa'i mthun pa'i rdzas/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul sngags rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /rab 'byams zhing khams bkang ste 'bul lags na/ /dges shing brtse ba'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang / /phan bde'i lung rtogs bshad sgrub rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan 'jig rten bde skyid dar/ /khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/

/sdig sgrib nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad srungs/ /legs tshogs kun spel bsam pa'i don kun 'grub/ /srid bzhi'i dpal 'byor dbang bsdus 'phral yun bde/ log lta zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /mi mthun nyer 'tshe thal ba rdul du rlog /bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs shig sa mā ya/ /kyai 'dod khro rmongs pa'i dbang gis sdig bgyis gang / /dam can rgya mtshor ma dad ma gus sogs/ /mi shes gti mug 'gal 'khrul ci mchis kun/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings su mthol lo bshags/ /kyai rnam dag chos dbyings ngang las gdul bya'i ngor/ /gtum drag ging dang rab 'jigs khro mo'i skur/ /yongs shar 'dir bzhugs dam can rgya mtsho la/ /rab gus dang ba'i sems kyis bdag bstod do/ /kyai bstan bsrung dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag gi mchod gtor 'di bzhes 'phrin las mdzod/ /rang rang bzhugs pa'i zhing du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren gsol/ /oṃ badzra muḥ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed skur gsal ba'i/ /gnas gsum yig 'bru'i rgyas btab bar chad bsrung / /dge des bdag gzhan ma gyur 'gro ba kun/ /myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs byang thob phyir bsngo/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /yi dam lha yi dngos grub dge mtshan mtho/ /dam can srung ma'i bdud dpung g.yul ngo bzlog /'phral dang yun du dge ba'i bkra shis shog/ //ces bstan bsrung rags bsdus la mchod gtor 'bul tshul 'di yang rtse drung skal bzang bstan dar gyi zhal 'don du sa skya pa kun blos mgyogs par sbyar// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gtor bsngo don 'dus ma/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
